notes: SRT is treated as a deliberately bounded interoperable subset: optional numeric cue index, strict hh:mm:ss,mmm timing line, then one or more text lines.
WebVTT coverage follows the W3C timing/header model but deliberately rejects cue settings and NOTE/STYLE/REGION blocks in this ticket.
The default 17 CPS reading-speed threshold is a configurable reference from the Netflix Italian Timed Text Style Guide, not universal truth.
